verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents exporting OTLP metrics for generative AI, MCP and A2A traffic through an OpenTelemetry AI Policy. It also says logs and metrics can be analyzed in Konnect or any OpenTelemetry tool, using a standardized AI log format. Distributed trace export is never explicitly documented, and there are no step-by-step log-shipping details, so only part of the story (logs and metrics, not traces) is evidenced. missing for 10: explicit trace/span export documentation, concrete log-export sink configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export gateway logs and traces to my own observability stack

citations.quote: AI Gateway can export OpenTelemetry (OTLP) metrics for generative AI, MCP, and A2A traffic through an OpenTelemetry AI Policy.
You can gather logs and metrics then analyze these using Konnect or any OpenTelemetry tool.
AI Gateway provides a standardized logging format for AI Policies, enabling the emission of analytics events
